inspection_method: shallow git clone plus README and CONTRIBUTING inspection

anchors.why: Main registry of official and community agent skills, category layout, path table, quality criteria, and security notice.
Contribution rules: entry format, category placement, requirements, and link-only curation boundary.

known_limits: This repo is primarily a curated link registry, not a runtime or validator.
Listed skills live in external repositories and were not individually audited in this source review.
Community adoption and inclusion are not evidence of safety, correctness, or action readiness.
